statement: β × γ → α} (hf : BddAbove (Set.range f)) : ⨆ p, f p = ⨆ b, ⨆ c, f (b, c)

name: ciSup_subtype
statement: ι → Prop} {f : Subtype p → α} (hf : BddAbove (Set.range f)) (hf' : sSup ∅ ≤ iSup f) : iSup f = ⨆ (i) (h : p i), f ⟨i, h⟩

name: ciSup_image
statement: Type*} {s : Set ι} {f : ι → ι'} {g : ι' → α} (hf : BddAbove (Set.range fun i : s ↦ g (f i))) (hg' : sSup ∅ ≤ ⨆ i : s, g (f i)) : ⨆ i ∈ (f '' s), g i = ⨆ x ∈ s, g (f x)

name: cbiSup_eq_of_not_forall

name: ciInf_eq_iff
statement: ι → α) (n : α) : ⨅ i, (f i) = n ↔ (∃ i, f i = n) ∧ ∀ i, n ≤ f i
